title: TAP Event
description:
A signed, tamper-evident record of one agent action. Normative definition: TAP-spec-v0.1.md [TAP-EVT-ENVELOPE]. This schema is a convenience for implementers and tooling; where it and the specification disagree, the specification governs.

Two rules this schema encodes that are easy to miss:

1. Absent optional fields are OMITTED, never null [TAP-EVT-OMIT] — `null` and absent are different signed bytes, so two Signers that disagree here produce structurally different events for logically identical actions. `additionalProperties` stays true (extensions are allowed), but the optional fields below are deliberately NOT nullable.
2. No fractional numbers anywhere in a signed body [TAP-CANON-NUMBERS]. JSON Schema cannot express 'no non-integer number anywhere', so integer-typed fields are constrained individually and quantities that are conceptually fractional (a decision `score`) are typed as strings.

event_id.description: Unique, sortable. Committed to by checkpoint Merkle roots, so it MUST come from a CSPRNG.

aid.description: Agent instance id, unique per record.

seq.description: 1-based, monotonic per aid. Gaps and duplicates are integrity signals [TAP-EVT-SEQ].

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC, milliseconds. Inside the signed body, so it also bounds key revocation [TAP-KEY-REVOCATION].

intent_digest.description: OPTIONAL — omit when absent. A checkpoint action carries none.

tool.description: NULLABLE and always present: tool name, target agent id, or null where the action has no target.

scope_used.description: NULLABLE and always present. Matched against Passport scope by EXACT string equality [TAP-SCOPE-MATCH].

args_digest.description: OPTIONAL — omit when absent. SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical args.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL — omit entirely when empty, never send as null.

nego.description: The observed handshake outcome, bound into the FIRST Event of a record where a handshake occurred, and omitted where none did [TAP-NEGO-BINDING].

suite.description: A TAP suite id from registries/suites.json — NOT a JOSE `alg` value.

code.description: From registries/result-codes.json, or a namespaced `x.<vendor>.<code>`. Verifiers MUST preserve unknown codes verbatim [TAP-RESULT-CODES].

latency_ms.description: OPTIONAL — omit when not measured. Integer: no fractional numbers in a signed body.

error.description: NULLABLE and always present: null means 'no error', which is a value rather than an absence.

effect_digest.description: OPTIONAL — omit when absent or unmeasured. Digest of the action's actual resulting state, compared against authorization.target_state_digest [TAP-AUTHORITY-EFFECT, §9.2, provisional].

action_ref.description: OPTIONAL — correlates the agent and server legs of one action.

parent_event_id.description: OPTIONAL — omit when absent. Links a received_delegation to its agent_delegate.

policy_version.description: Digest over the canonical policy set in force — lets an auditor prove WHICH policy governed a historical action.

kid.description: Inside the signed body, so it cannot be swapped without breaking the signature.

actionKind.description: One of the registered kinds, or a namespaced `x-` extension. Verifiers MUST preserve unknown kinds verbatim [TAP-EVT-KIND].

decisionBlock.description: The counterfactual ledger [TAP-EVT-DECISION]: the option taken AND the options rejected, with reasons, all inside the signing input so the option set cannot be revised after the fact.

chosen.description: MUST equal the id of the one option with chosen: true.

score.description: A STRING, e.g. "0.71" — fractional numbers are forbidden in a signed body [TAP-CANON-NUMBERS].

checkpointBlock.description: Seals a segment of the record [TAP-EVT-CHECKPOINT]. The interval is half-open and SELF-DESCRIBING: (from_seq, through_seq], so a Verifier can reconcile one checkpoint without reconstructing the state of whichever checkpoint preceded it.

from_seq.description: EXCLUSIVE lower bound; 0 for the first checkpoint of a record.

event_id_root.description: Merkle root over the event_ids in the interval, ordered by seq ascending.

count.description: MUST equal the number of event_ids committed by event_id_root.

authorizationBlock.description: PROVISIONAL [TAP-EVT-AUTHORIZATION, §9.2] — normative in shape, no reference Verifier/SDK enforces it yet. Binds this Event to a pre-declared expected effect under a versioned, time-bounded, revocable approval.

authz_id.description: Unique per approval. MUST NOT be presented by more than one Event [TAP-AUTHORITY-REUSE].

authority_state_version.description: Same digest construction as policy_version (§9.1), scoped to this approval.

target_state_digest.description: Digest of the expected resulting state this action was approved to produce.

exp.description: Expiry, epoch seconds. Checked with the same +-60s skew as Passport validation [TAP-AUTHORITY-VALIDITY].

issuer_kid.description: Key that granted this approval; MAY differ from the Event's own signing kid.
